title: Night Force #2 DC 1982 Marv Wolfman Gene Colan Baron Winters Horror Bronze
condition_description: Bright, glossy cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned. See photos.
description:
Night Force #2 (September 1982), DC Comics - "The Summoning, Chapter 2: The Burning Hand." Written by Marv Wolfman, pencils by Gene Colan. Cover by Gene Colan and Dick Giordano. Featuring Baron Winters. 60 cent cover price.

Back cover: TSR Dungeons & Dragons comic-strip ad.

Condition: bright, glossy cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
